summary: Rabbi Joseph Beyda discusses the upcoming day of Yom Kippur and how its powerful spiritual cleansing and atonement are achieved. He uses Abraham Lincoln's analogy of sharpening an axe to explain that the spiritual height of the day comes from all the preparation and hard work put in beforehand.
questions: How does Yom Kippur bring atonement?
What is the lesson of Abraham Lincoln's axe story regarding Yom Kippur?
What preparations lead up to Yom Kippur?
